The listing detail has the button "Message the lister" of the designs

tasks.title: Message alerts: email and push
tasks.plain: Tell a person about a new request or message by email and browser push.
done: A new request or message sends an email and a browser push, with no message text, unless the user turned them off
Settings has the "Email alerts" and "Push alerts" switches of the designs

tasks.title: ID verification
tasks.plain: A person checks an ID and a selfie, and roomsie keeps only the result.
done: A person sends a non-Aadhaar government ID and a selfie from the verification step of flow 04 or from Settings. A listing goes live before the review
A named reviewer approves or rejects each check in a screen that only named accounts open. Each view of a document goes in an audit log
The person sees the state of the check: in review, verified, or rejected with the reason and a way to send a new ID
The system stores the result, the method and the date. It deletes the ID photo and the selfie right after the review
The Verified badge on the cards and the detail screens uses the result

tasks.title: Saved
tasks.plain: Save a person or a place, and see them again under Saved.
done: A signed-in user saves and unsaves a place or a person, with the Save button of the designs
Saved in the sidebar and in the phone bar lists the saved places, with the empty state of the designs

tasks.title: Onboarding questions
tasks.plain: The first questions after sign-in: area, budget, place type, who is moving and purpose.
done: The screens of flow 01 ask the area, the monthly budget, the place type, who is moving and the purpose, as in the Product file
The answers fill the same Form A slots that the chat fills
The profile completion card shows the percentage, as in the designs

tasks.title: Compare selected cards
tasks.plain: Select some cards, and the assistant compares them in the chat.
done: A user selects two or more cards, and the chat shows them above the input, as in "Listings selected"
The assistant compares only the selected cards, and only from their database fields
scope-policy.md allows the comparison before the build starts. Today, the assistant states no facts about listings

tasks.title: Found a place, share and feedback
tasks.plain: Close a search when the user finds a place, share a card, and send feedback.
done: "I found a place" closes the goal, as in its popover, and logs an event
Share gives a link to a card, as in the Share modal. The link opens the card behind the login gate
The feedback popover saves the feedback of the user

tasks.title: Apply migrations and the seed in the deploy
tasks.plain: The live database gets each new table before the new server starts.
done: A merge to main applies the committed migrations to the main database before the new API starts
The deploy runs the catalogue seed. A second run changes nothing
A failed migration stops the deploy. The API stays on the version before

tasks.title: Content-Security-Policy for the web
tasks.plain: The browser runs only our own scripts, so an injected script cannot steal a sign-in.
done: Each page serves a strict Content-Security-Policy, with a new nonce for each request
Google sign-in, the API and the photo storage still work under the policy
A test checks the header. A script without the nonce does not run
